$comment: What the legacy arm (SAUCE_TEST_EVM_ARM / SAUCE_TEST_SVM_ARM = legacy) runs, by target. Every suite under sdk/test, mcp/test and actions/tests that starts an engine is in `run` or in `skip` with its reason (sdk/test/legacy-arm.test.ts holds this).

dev-tools is out of scope: the testing kit is shipped code, reads no environment and always runs the installed release (T17 and T18 test its routing); svm-local.test.ts checks the dev harness's runner.
